review.method: AI visual review of all 56 original images against the front reference; first-run selection, not trained performance.
limitations: All candidates share synthetic source ancestry; validation is diagnostic, not independent generalization.
No new-scene identity performance has been measured.
Excluded candidates are retained unchanged; exclusion may reflect redundancy or framing rather than generation failure.
review.correction: The old split remains withdrawn. P7-5.2 has been re-reviewed: candidate suitability and sampling role are separate from pending train/validation assignment. No image has been conclusively rejected for identity corruption; this is not proof all views are geometrically consistent.
